info.title: Cyber-Scout API
info.description: Accounts, roles, settings and shared scouting data. Cookie session auth; send X-CSRF-Token (= cs_csrf cookie) on mutating requests. Roles: viewer < scout < strategist < admin. Site JSON (/api/*) and media (/media/*) are served by nginx, gated by GET /app/v1/auth/check. Mutating requests may carry Idempotency-Key (replayed for 48 h per user); client sync: /app/v1/info, /app/v1/sync/* (docs/SYNC.md).

The season's events (TBA /events/{year}/simple, cached an hour) ranked against `q` (words match the start of
a word of the name, city, state, district or the key).  Empty q: events on now, soon and just ended first, your
team's events next.  A full event key from another season is looked up directly.  The TBA key never leaves
the server.

get.summary: Match video mode + livestream-only readiness (viewer+)
get.description:
video_mode: auto (per-match uploads, plus the livestream clip when the stream is trackable) or livestream
(offseason: TBA gives the match list; every match is tracked from the recorded livestream, never an upload).
checks: what livestream-only mode needs (stream source, recorder, layout field box, calibration, TBA).
suggested / suggested_why: the default the Video page offers (livestream for an offseason event without
match videos on TBA); chosen: an admin has set the mode (else the event runs on the default, auto).

delete.description:
An admin-added source is deleted.  A TBA source (event webcast, upload family) is switched off and marked
`dismissed`: TBA discovery keeps it off, and the recorder doesn't fall back to TBA's webcasts.  Restore it
with PATCH {"dismissed": false, "enabled": true}.  Layout boxes are kept either way.

get.summary: Livestream recorder status (viewer+)
get.description:
What the recorder service (compose service `recorder`, live/liveingest.py) is doing for this event:
state (recording / waiting / stream_over / idle / error / no_source / disabled / stopped), the source and
video, recorder + analyser progress (behind_live_s, analyser.behind_chunks x 5 s), the last detected
match and recent ones (teams, score, flags, clip URL under /media/), disk use, recent errors, and whether
the stream can be tracked (tracking.ok / note).  Written to DATA/events/<ev>/livestream.json.

get.summary: Per-match video plan: candidates, detected types, choices (viewer+)
get.description:
Which upload the tracker uses for every match (live/videoplan.py): candidates with their detected type
(wide / broadcast / stations), duplicates, the choice and why, plus the admin overrides.  Built by the worker
every poll and by POST .../video-plan/check; null until the first build.

ytdlp.title: Ytdlp
ytdlp.description: also re-pin yt-dlp to its newest release (worker image: small rebuild)

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: manifest paths (api/<ev>/... or global api/<file>); at most 64 MB in total

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.description: pipeline version it runs: 409 when outdated

skip.title: Skip
skip.description: match keys it failed on recently

job.title: Job
job.description: null = nothing to do now; else ev, key, match, event, live, camera, pose_guess, clip {url,size,sha256}, view_ref {url,size,sha256}|null, urls, claim_s, heartbeat_s, pipeline

counts.title: Counts
counts.description: per state: tracked, claimed (by others), yours (held by this processor: never handed out twice), waiting (no trackable clip), failed

ClipRecord.title: ClipRecord
ClipRecord.description: The match record a client cut (live/liveingest.py tba_cut): only these fields; the server sets the clip path.

when.title: When
when.description: now | soon (within 14 days) | recent (ended within 14 days) | later | past

short_name.title: Short Name
short_name.description: TBA short name, e.g. Sammamish (site build)

updated.title: Updated
updated.description: last site build (unix s); null = never built

needs_setup.title: Needs Setup
needs_setup.description: no camera calibration yet: matches are not tracked until Video setup

url.title: Url
url.description: path on this server (prefix the server address)

line_clicks.title: Line Clicks
line_clicks.description: field line -> [[u, v], ...] (any points along it, >= 2)

version.title: Version
version.description: git short sha of the deployed code (or src-<content hash> / dev)

name.title: Name
name.description: server display name (SERVER_NAME, else Cyber-Scout + team number)

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: opaque; send back as ?since= for the changes after this manifest

full.title: Full
full.description: true: `files` is everything (no/unknown/expired cursor); delete local files not in it

text.title: Text
text.description: plain text: render with textContent / escaped, never as HTML

edited_by.title: Edited By
edited_by.description: set when someone other than the author last edited it

gpu_device.title: Gpu Device
gpu_device.description: CUDA device index inside the worker container

hubcam.title: Hubcam
hubcam.description: optional driver-station camera pass (~1-2 min/match extra)

Options.title: Options
Options.description: Worker options; null = use the worker's default / its .env value.

PicklistData.title: PicklistData
PicklistData.description:
Strict shape (web/event.js): team keys and numeric weights only -- anything else is rejected, so a
strategist can't store markup that another user's browser renders (security audit finding 1).

base_version.title: Base Version
base_version.description: optimistic concurrency: 409 if the stored version differs

version.title: Version
version.description: content hash of the pipeline code; claims carry it, a different one -> 409

code.description: gzip tar: live/, src/, runner.py, requirements.txt, PIPELINE.json

model.description: the robot detector (robot.onnx); null = none on the server yet

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: pip requirements of the processing Python

runtimes.title: Runtimes
runtimes.description: requirements per runtime: cuda (NVIDIA), coreml (Apple silicon), clip (Clip only, no GPU)

clip_extras.title: Clip Extras
clip_extras.description: added to every runtime (Clip only tools)

ytdlp_requirements.title: Ytdlp Requirements
ytdlp_requirements.description: hash-pinned yt-dlp requirements file in the code tarball (uv pip install --require-hashes --no-deps)

claim_s.title: Claim S
claim_s.description: a claim not refreshed for this long is stale and handed to someone else

pin.title: Pin
pin.description: video id / URL the tracker must use for this match

pin_stations.title: Pin Stations
pin_stations.description: video id / URL for the station cameras

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: video ids never used for this match

add.title: Add
add.description: extra video ids / URLs for this match

failed.title: Failed
failed.description: true: it failed on this processor (after MAX_FAILS the processors leave the match to the worker)

since.title: Since
since.description: unix seconds: undo this account's changes made at or after this time

include_admins.title: Include Admins
include_admins.description: also sign out the other admins (your own session always stays)

lockdown.title: Lockdown
lockdown.description: null, or {on, at, by:{id,display_name}}: non-admin writes are refused (423)

passwordless_login.title: Passwordless Login
passwordless_login.description: where accounts without a password may sign in: never | lan (direct from a private/Tailscale address, not through the tunnel; default) | everywhere

scout_overrides.title: Scout Overrides
scout_overrides.description: review (default): scouts' identity fixes wait for a strategist/admin; direct: applied at once

setup_required.title: Setup Required
setup_required.description: no users yet: the UI must show the first-run wizard

setup_code_required.title: Setup Code Required
setup_code_required.description: setup needs the one-time code from DATA/setup-code.txt

user.title: User
user.description: {id, username, display_name, role} or null when signed out

csrf.title: Csrf
csrf.description: send as X-CSRF-Token on POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE (also in the cs_csrf cookie)

configured.title: Configured
configured.description: TBA key set, at least one followed event, and the setup wizard finished

lockdown.title: Lockdown
lockdown.description: read-only mode: only admins can change anything right now

network.title: Network
network.description: 'lan' (direct from the team network / Tailscale) or 'public' (tunnel)

passwordless_ok.title: Passwordless Ok
passwordless_ok.description: accounts without a password can sign in from here

setup_complete.title: Setup Complete
setup_complete.description: an admin finished the setup wizard (imported .env values don't count)

url.title: Url
url.description: YouTube/Twitch URL (video, livestream, playlist, channel), direct .mp4/.m3u8 URL, or a file path under the media/data dir

label.title: Label
label.description: null: a short name from the link

station.title: Station
station.description: alliance-side only: red | blue (which driver-station camera)

live.title: Live
live.description: true: a YouTube video link of a stream that is live / scheduled (recorded like a /live link); channel /live and Twitch channels are live anyway

url.title: Url
url.description: replace the link (admin-added sources only; keeps the id, so its layout boxes and calibration stay)

dismissed.title: Dismissed
dismissed.description: false: restore a removed TBA source (with enabled: true)

rec.title: Rec
rec.description: recorder progress {chunks, bytes, behind_s, last_wall, video}

status.title: Status
status.description: needs_setup (no camera calibration) | upcoming | in_progress | finished

installed.title: Installed
installed.description: false: no updater heartbeat in the last 3 minutes (not installed / stopped)

role.title: Role
role.description: least privilege: new accounts are viewers unless you pick a role

password.title: Password
password.description: admin password reset ('' = no password, non-admins only); signs the user out

video_mode.title: Video Mode
video_mode.description: auto = per-match uploads + livestream | livestream = livestream only (TBA gives the match list; no upload is looked up)
